text: The Romans did in these instances what all prudent princes ought to do, who have to regard not only present troubles, but also future ones, for which they must prepare with every energy, because, when foreseen, it is easy to remedy them; but if you wait until they approach, the medicine is no longer in time because the malady has become incurable.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
